== pipeline ==

== what changed in this build ==
  app_name            : JVHD -> JVHD Vip2   (res/values/strings.xml)
  assets/index.html   : <title>JVHD -> JVHD Vip2
  assets/app.js       : /config retry (JVHD_CONFIG_RETRY_COUNT=2) + error panel
                        with a 'Thu lai' button instead of cancel + toast
  MainActivity.smali  : onCreate WebView bring-up wrapped in a catch-all that
                        shows a native error screen; onKeyDown guards the
                        lateinit webView
  new class           : Lcom/bintv/launcher/MainActivity$StartupRetryListener;
                        (classes.dex now defines 838 classes, was 837)
  unchanged           : applicationId com.bintv.launcher, launcher activity,
                        minSdk 21 / targetSdk 33, landscape, MediaProxyServer,
                        TizenBridge, BtK, libbtcore.so (arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a)

== headless UI regression test (jsdom driving the real assets/app.js) ==
  scenario A: /config always fails  -> gate stays, error panel + 'Thu lai', 3 attempts, BACK opens exit dialog
  scenario B: 'Thu lai' after the server warms up -> JVHD screen opens
  scenario C: one transient failure -> absorbed by the automatic retry
  scenario D: 'Huy' on the error panel -> explicit user exit
  result: 21/21 checks passed

  - remote-control focus traversal on the native error screen
